profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer II @Honeywell Aerospace
profile.summary: Innovation-driven software engineer dedicated to solving complex integration challenges and advancing technical expertise in embedded engineering. Passionate about delivering high-quality, reliable solutions that exceed today’s rigorous standards, with a focus on hardware-software integration and strong experience in Linux and C/C++.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Role & Specialization: 
- Focused on embedded solutions for satellite communications (satcom) within Honeywell’s Jetwave program.

Project Scope: 
- Developed a key application within a suite of satellite apps, designed to interface with an external third-party amplifier, that was integral for managing transmission signals enabling the satellite to send and receive critical communications.

Technical Skills & Contributions:
- Serial Communication: Implemented functionality to send and receive messages over serial communication, working with hex-byte data. Converted this raw data into actionable information for both the application and the amplifier, ensuring clear and accurate data exchange.
- Protocol Integration: Implemented both standard OpenAMIP commands and custom commands specifically for the third-party amplifier, enabling reliable integration with our project's existing systems.
- Data Translation: Worked extensively on message translation to bridge the data requirements between our in-house apps and the amplifier, which involved detailed handling of communication protocols to maintain compatibility and function.

Achievements:
- Enhanced the reliability and robustness of the satellite’s communication systems by resolving bugs, optimizing code, and streamlining processes within the application.
- Addressed complex integration challenges, ensuring efficient data handling and consistent system performance within a multi-application environment.

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Used schematic capture programs such as Mentor to analyze and debug satellite power supply hardware to validate effectiveness, efficiency, and proper performance
- Extensively performed thermal and power tests on the power supply unit within the satellite enclosure to test stability at extreme temperatures and high or exceeding loads
- Created custom loads with high power resistors to draw the maximum amount of power while virtually purposing as real world loads for use in both thermal and power testing

positions.title: Hardware Assembly Assistant
positions.description:
- Responsible for preparing parts, assembling sub-assemblies, and helping calibrate completed scientific instruments within the Mercury department of final assembly. 
- Specifically worked on the Autopore Series, which utilized Mercury to find the porosity of certain substances.
- Became certified to handle mercury within my time at Micromeritics.

educations.schoolName: University of Georgia College of Engineering

volunteerExperiences.description: Helped build houses, restore properties, and clear out forested areas to create new and very affordable housing for families needing a home.
